Tests transaction packing, scheduling, deletion, expiration, nonce, bundle, and limit rules.

# Purpose
This file is a test and benchmark program for the `fd_pack` transaction packer and scheduler. It builds many synthetic transactions, vote transactions, nonce transactions, and bundles, then inserts them into a `fd_pack_t` instance and checks the results of packing, conflict detection, expiration, deletion, and scheduling. The code also verifies block limits such as compute unit cost, vote cost, write cost per account, data size, and transaction count per microblock. The [`main`](<#main>) function runs all tests and performance cases, so this file is an executable test harness rather than a library file.

The file defines helper routines to construct valid transaction payloads with controlled account lists, instruction data, signatures, and compute budget instructions. It then uses these helpers in test cases such as [`test_delete`](<#test_delete>), [`test_expiration`](<#test_expiration>), [`test_limits`](<#test_limits>), [`test_nonce`](<#test_nonce>), and [`test_bundle_nonce`](<#test_bundle_nonce>) to check public `fd_pack` APIs like `fd_pack_insert_txn_init`, `fd_pack_insert_txn_fini`, `fd_pack_schedule_next_microblock`, `fd_pack_microblock_complete`, `fd_pack_expire_before`, `fd_pack_delete_transaction`, and `fd_pack_verify`. It also includes performance tests that measure insert and schedule cost under different heap sizes and writer counts.
